channel.title: Flog It!
channel.desc: The teams are at the Old College, a part of Aberystwyth University on the West Coast of Wales. A grade one listed building and the first University in Wales. Our experts Christina Trevanion and Raj Bisram are on hand to find a selection of objects to take to auction. Christina values a pair of Wedgwood plates, while a gold guinea impresses Raj. Paul Martin visits a Victorian tourist attraction that paved the way for modern photography.
